see.name: The Serangoon House
see.blurb: A little slice of theatrical India on Serangoon Road, imagined by Jacques Garcia with hand-painted de Gournay wallpaper, custom chandeliers, marble, brass and velvet.
see.hours: Hotel public areas open daily; access to certain spaces may depend on hotel operations

see.name: The Vagabond Club
see.blurb: Part boutique hotel, part cabinet of curiosities, with Jacques Garcia interiors, dramatic art and unexpected objects tucked into nearly every corner.
see.hours: Hotel public areas open daily; access to certain spaces may depend on hotel operations

see.name: Indian Heritage Centre
see.blurb: A contemporary museum tracing the journeys, traditions and stories of Singapore's Indian communities across generations.

see.name: Malay Heritage Centre
see.blurb: Set within the former royal grounds of Kampong Gelam, this cultural center explores Singapore's Malay heritage and its connections across the wider Malay world.

see.name: Former House of Tan Teng Niah
see.blurb: Little India's technicolor scene-stealer and one of the district's last surviving Chinese villas, dressed today in an impossible-to-ignore rainbow facade.

see.name: Gelam Gallery
see.blurb: An outdoor gallery threaded through Kampong Gelam's back lanes, where walls and alleyways become canvases for Singaporean and international street artists.

see.name: National Design Centre
see.blurb: Singapore's hub for exhibitions, installations and ideas about how design shapes everyday life, housed within a beautifully adapted historic complex.

see.name: Aliwal Arts Centre
see.blurb: A creative hub in the heart of Kampong Gelam, bringing together artists, performances, exhibitions and independent cultural programming under one roof.

see.name: Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple
see.blurb: One of Little India's oldest Hindu temples, crowned by an extraordinary tower packed with colorful deities and intricate sculpture.

see.name: Arya Samaj Singapore
see.blurb: A century-old Hindu institution with roots in Singapore dating to 1927, bringing together religion, education and community heritage along Syed Alwi Road.

see.name: Sultan Mosque
see.blurb: The golden-domed heart of Kampong Gelam and one of Singapore's most recognizable landmarks, rooted in the district's royal Malay history.
see.hours: Saturday–Thursday, 10:00 AM–12:00 PM and 2:00 PM–4:00 PM; closed Friday to visitors

see.name: Kampong Kapor Methodist Church
see.blurb: A quietly elegant church standing in Little India since 1930, with roots stretching back to one of Singapore's earliest Peranakan Christian congregations.
see.hours: Worship services and church programs vary

see.name: Mustafa Centre
see.blurb: Singapore's legendary everything-store, where groceries, gold, electronics, perfume and approximately nine things you did not come in for live under one roof.

see.name: Little India Arcade
see.blurb: A maze of heritage shophouses packed with sweets, textiles, jewelry, henna, garlands and enough color to make beige feel personally attacked.
see.hours: Individual shops vary; generally daytime to evening

see.name: Haji Lane
see.blurb: A tiny street with an oversized personality, lined with murals, boutiques, bars, vintage finds and some of Kampong Gelam's most photographed shopfronts.
see.hours: Street accessible 24 hours; individual businesses vary

do.name: Craft Your Own Leather Piece at Crafune
do.blurb: Cut, stitch and personalize your own leather creation at this homegrown atelier, then walk away with something considerably better than another souvenir keychain.
do.hours: Daily, 11:00 AM–6:00 PM; advance booking required for workshops

do.name: Get Your Hands Dirty at Dirty Hands Only
do.blurb: Take a lump of clay, add a pottery wheel and see what happens. Beginner-friendly sessions cover wheel throwing and hand-building, with small class sizes and plenty of room for wonky first attempts.
do.hours: Monday–Saturday, 12:00 PM–6:00 PM; Sunday, 11:00 AM–6:00 PM; workshop timings vary

do.name: Make Art Without the Rules at Artistra Studio
do.blurb: Pick up a brush and make something entirely your own, from classic art jamming to painted sneakers. Artistic credentials are very much not required.
do.hours: Tuesday–Friday, 12:00 PM–9:30 PM; Saturday–Sunday, 11:00 AM–10:00 PM; closed Monday

do.name: Make Your Own Rug at About You Studio
do.blurb: Choose a design, grab a tufting gun and turn a bundle of yarn into a rug you can actually take home. Far more satisfying than buying one ready-made.
do.address: 1 Rochor Canal Road, #02-39, Sim Lim Square, Singapore 188504
do.hours: Tuesday–Friday, 10:30 AM–8:00 PM; Saturday–Sunday, 10:00 AM–7:30 PM; closed Monday

do.name: Get a Henna Design at Jayaram's Creation
do.blurb: Pick your pattern, offer up a hand and let intricate lines, florals and traditional motifs do the decorating. The hardest part may be choosing which design you want.
do.address: 48 Serangoon Road, #01-23, Little India Arcade, Singapore 217959
do.hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:30 AM–9:00 PM; Sunday, 9:30 AM–6:00 PM

do.name: Build Your Own Fragrance at Perfumeplay
do.blurb: Follow your nose through different scent profiles before blending a fragrance that is entirely yours. Your holiday now comes with its own smell, in the best possible way.
do.hours: Monday–Saturday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM; Sunday, 10:00 AM–8:00 PM

do.name: Slow Down Over Tea at Atelier Cherub
do.blurb: Tucked above North Bridge Road, this intimate tea studio turns Chinese tea appreciation into a deliciously unhurried affair of leaves, teaware, stories and proper pause-the-day-for-a-moment energy.
do.hours: Daily, 10:00 AM–9:00 PM; tea experiences and workshops by reservation

do.name: Catch Live Jazz at The Whiskey Library & Jazz Club
do.blurb: Sink into a velvet chair, order something worth sipping and let the evening take care of itself, with live jazz bringing The Vagabond Club to life three nights a week.
do.hours: Live jazz every Thursday, Friday and Saturday from 8:30 PM; reservations required

do.name: Try Batik Tulis at Ozel
do.blurb: Learn the traditional art of hand-drawn batik using hot wax, a canting tool and color, then leave with your own textile artwork and a newfound respect for anyone who makes those lines look effortless.
do.address: 390 Victoria Street, #03-20, Golden Landmark Shopping Centre, Singapore 188061
do.hours: Tuesday–Saturday, 11:00 AM–7:00 PM; Sunday, 1:00 PM–5:00 PM; workshop timings vary and advance booking is recommended

do.name: Explore Little India with Culture Curious
do.blurb: Go beyond the colorful facades with a local guide who brings Little India's faiths, food, trades and everyday stories into focus. Consider it the neighborhood with the footnotes switched on.
do.hours: Tea & Tiffin Tour runs Friday–Saturday, 9:30 AM–12:00 PM; private tour timings vary

eat.name: Gupshup
eat.blurb: Bold Indian flavors, generous plates and plenty of personality, all tucked beneath The Serangoon House. Come hungry and bring someone who does not mind sharing.
eat.address: 301 Serangoon Road, Basement 1, The Serangoon House, Singapore 218224
eat.hours: Daily, 12:00 PM–2:30 PM and 5:00 PM–9:30 PM

eat.name: The Whiskey Library & Jazz Club
eat.blurb: Rare whiskies, polished cocktails and a suitably moody room inside The Vagabond Club. Best enjoyed slowly, preferably with nowhere else to be.
eat.address: 39 Syed Alwi Road, The Vagabond Club, Singapore 207630
eat.hours: Daily, 12:00 PM–3:00 PM and from 4:00 PM; closes 11:00 PM Sunday–Wednesday and 12:00 AM Thursday–Saturday

eat.name: The Coconut Club Beach Road
eat.blurb: A polished celebration of Singaporean cooking where coconut gets the starring role, from fragrant rice to rich, comforting plates that make restraint rather difficult.
eat.hours: Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–3:30 PM and 5:30 PM–10:30 PM; Saturday–Sunday, 11:00 AM–10:30 PM

eat.name: Cicheti
eat.blurb: A cozy Kampong Gelam trattoria serving wood-fired pizzas, handmade pastas and Italian comfort food built for ordering too much and sharing anyway.
eat.hours: Daily, 12:00 PM–2:30 PM and from 6:00 PM; closes 9:30 PM Sunday–Thursday and 10:00 PM Friday–Saturday

eat.name: The Malayan Council – Bussorah
eat.blurb: Malay flavors meet Western comfort food in a menu that happily ignores culinary borders. Expect generous portions, bold sauces and absolutely no interest in being subtle.

eat.name: Pita Bakery
eat.blurb: Warm pita straight from the oven, creamy hummus, falafel and Middle Eastern comfort food served with very little fuss and very good reason to order seconds.
eat.hours: Monday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–9:00 PM; Friday–Sunday, 9:00 AM–9:30 PM

eat.name: Symmetry
eat.blurb: Part brunch spot, part modern Australian restaurant, part "we came for coffee and somehow stayed for dinner." A dependable all-day stop on Jalan Kubor.
eat.hours: Mon & Tue 9:00 AM–9:00 PM · Wed–Fri 10:00 AM–11:00 PM · Sat 8:30 AM–11:00 PM · Sun 8:30 AM–7:00 PM

eat.name: Tipo Pasta Bar – Aliwal
eat.blurb: Fresh pasta with a choose-your-own-adventure spirit. Pick your pasta, sauce and add-ons, then pretend the combination was carefully planned all along.
eat.hours: Sun–Thu, 12:00 PM–9:00 PM; Fri–Sat, 12:00 PM–10:00 PM

eat.name: Rich & Good Cake Shop
eat.blurb: Soft, old-school Swiss rolls filled with familiar local flavors and exactly the sort of thing you buy "for later" before eating immediately.
eat.address: 180 Kitchener Road, #B2-21, City Square Mall, Singapore 208539

eat.name: Overrice
eat.blurb: New York-style halal street food gets a local home near Sultan Gate, with loaded rice bowls built for quick lunches, late cravings and very little ceremony.

eat.name: Mother Dough Bakery
eat.blurb: A tiny neighborhood bakery where sourdough, laminated pastries and small-batch bakes have a habit of disappearing long before closing time.

eat.name: Tolido's Espresso Nook
eat.blurb: A cozy Crawford Lane favorite for proper coffee, hearty breakfasts and brunch plates that make waking up early feel considerably less offensive.
eat.hours: Mon–Tue & Thu 8:00 AM–4:00 PM · Fri–Sun 8:00 AM–5:00 PM · closed Wed

eat.name: Swee Choon Tim Sum Restaurant
eat.blurb: A Jalan Besar institution serving baskets of dim sum from breakfast through supper. Come for one plate; leave after an alarming number of bamboo steamers.
eat.hours: Sun–Thu, 7:00 AM–2:00 AM; Fri–Sat, 7:00 AM–4:00 AM

eat.name: The Ramen Stall
eat.blurb: A halal Japanese favorite for rich bowls of ramen, sushi and comforting late-night plates, particularly useful when hunger strikes well past respectable dinner hours.
eat.hours: Sun–Thu, 11:00 AM–1:00 AM; Fri–Sat, 11:00 AM–2:00 AM

eat.name: Beirut Grill
eat.blurb: A lively Bussorah Street stop for Lebanese and Middle Eastern classics, from grilled meats and mezze to the very sensible decision of ordering far too much bread.
eat.hours: Daily, 11:30 AM–3:00 PM and 5:00 PM–11:00 PM

drive.name: Cultivate
drive.blurb: A fully plant-based dining experience at Maxwell Reserve, where organic, GMO-free and gluten-free ingredients are treated with the kind of attention usually reserved for the main event.
drive.address: 2 Cook Street, Maxwell Reserve Singapore, Autograph Collection, Singapore 078857

drive.name: Isabel
drive.blurb: Pink, polished and unapologetically glamorous, Isabel pairs European-inspired dishes with cocktails in a dining room designed for long lunches, celebratory dinners and staying for one more drink.
drive.address: 2 Cook Street, Maxwell Reserve Singapore, Autograph Collection, Singapore 078857

drive.name: Polo Bar Steakhouse
drive.blurb: A classic steakhouse with a little swagger, serving premium cuts, cocktails and spirits against a backdrop of polo-inspired interiors and old-world clubroom charm.
drive.address: 2 Cook Street, Maxwell Reserve Singapore, Autograph Collection, Singapore 078857
drive.hours: Tue–Thu 12:00 PM–3:00 PM & 5:00 PM–11:00 PM · Fri–Sat 12:00 PM–3:00 PM & 5:00 PM–12:00 AM · closed Sun & Mon

drive.name: Shikar
drive.blurb: Progressive Indian dining by Chef Jolly, where bold flavors, elegant technique and a sense of occasion come together in a setting made for lingering.
drive.address: 2 Cook Street, Maxwell Reserve Singapore, Autograph Collection, Singapore 078857
drive.hours: Daily, 12:00 PM–3:00 PM and 6:00 PM–10:00 PM
